about:
The TPM high-water anchor as the initrd reads it, decided by the Python: each case is the NV indices a
TPM holds (as membership.HighWater laid them out, driven through tests.test_baremetal_heartbeat.FakeTpm),
each with its authPolicy ("policy", null for none), the node's configured approved-image policy (the case's
"policy", null for none; #242), a chain from the ESP, and what Store.load decides before it writes anything.

cases.name: anchored at 3, the chain at 3
anchored at 3, the chain ahead at 6
a TPM that never held a counter
defined only (epoch 0, a zero digest), the chain at 1
anchored at 5, the chain at 3: a restored disk
cases.refused: ROLLBACK: the membership on disk is epoch 3 but the TPM high-water is 5; fetch the chain from a peer

cases.name: anchored at 3, another chain at 3
cases.refused: CONFLICT: the manifest at epoch 3 is not the one this node's TPM recorded: a substituted chain is never anchored; record an incident

cases.name: anchored at 3, another chain from epoch 4
the crash window: counter at 4, record at 3, the chain at 4
the crash window, another manifest at 4 (only 3 is pinned)
the crash window, another chain from 3
cases.refused: CONFLICT: the manifest at epoch 3 is not the one this node's TPM recorded: a substituted chain is never anchored; record an incident

cases.name: the record two epochs behind the counter
cases.unusable: the TPM record is for epoch 3 but the TPM high-water is 5: the anchor is inconsistent (fail closed)

cases.name: a record write cut after 0 bytes
a record write cut after 1 bytes
a record write cut after 7 bytes
a record write cut after 8 bytes
a record write cut after 20 bytes
a record write cut after 39 bytes
a record write cut after 40 bytes
a record write cut after 47 bytes
both slots holding no valid record
cases.unusable: NO RECORD: neither record slot (0x150001a, 0x150001b) holds a valid record: the anchor cannot tell which chain this node accepted (fail closed); re-anchor it (MEMBERSHIP-RECOVERY.md)

cases.name: one slot never written
both slots never written
cases.unusable: NO RECORD: neither record slot (0x150001a, 0x150001b) holds a valid record: the anchor cannot tell which chain this node accepted (fail closed); re-anchor it (MEMBERSHIP-RECOVERY.md)

cases.name: one slot holding garbage
a record slot that is gone
cases.unusable: cannot read NV index 0x150001b: the high-water anchor is unavailable (fail closed): the index is not defined

cases.name: the counter is gone
cases.unusable: cannot read NV index 0x1500016: the high-water anchor is unavailable (fail closed): the index is not defined

cases.name: the base is gone
cases.unusable: cannot read NV index 0x1500017: the high-water anchor is unavailable (fail closed): the index is not defined

cases.name: a slot others may write (authwrite)
cases.unusable: NV index 0x150001a does not have this anchor's attributes (0x60006, not 0x60002): it can be written or read otherwise than this software defines

cases.name: a slot under a policy (policywrite) with no authPolicy, on a node with none
cases.unusable: the anchor's write policy is not this node's approved-image policy: NV index 0x150001b is written by policy (none), and this node has none configured

cases.name: a slot the owner cannot read
cases.unusable: NV index 0x150001a does not have this anchor's attributes (0x40002, not 0x60002): it can be written or read otherwise than this software defines

cases.name: a write-locked slot
cases.unusable: NV index 0x150001a is write-locked: no record can be written to it

cases.name: a slot of 40 bytes
cases.unusable: record index 0x150001a is 40 bytes, not 48

cases.name: a slot that is a counter
cases.unusable: record index 0x150001a is not an ordinary index

cases.name: a counter others may write
cases.unusable: NV index 0x1500016 does not have this anchor's attributes (0x60016, not 0x60012): it can be written or read otherwise than this software defines

cases.name: a counter that clears at startup
cases.unusable: NV index 0x1500016 does not have this anchor's attributes (0x8060012, not 0x60012): it can be written or read otherwise than this software defines

cases.name: a counter never incremented
cases.unusable: NV index 0x1500016 is not a written counter

cases.name: a base that is not write-locked
cases.unusable: base index 0x1500017 is not written and write-locked

cases.name: a base others may write
cases.unusable: NV index 0x1500017 does not have this anchor's attributes (0x62006, not 0x62002): it can be written or read otherwise than this software defines

cases.name: a base of 4 bytes
cases.unusable: NV index 0x1500017 is 4 bytes, not 8

cases.name: a base of 16 bytes
cases.unusable: NV index 0x1500017 is 16 bytes, not 8

cases.name: a counter of 16 bytes (FakeTpm only: a TPM refuses it)
cases.unusable: NV index 0x1500016 is 16 bytes, not 8

cases.name: the counter below its base
cases.unusable: the NV counter 45 is below its base 1000000

cases.name: two slots at one epoch naming different manifests
cases.unusable: the two record slots name different manifests at epoch 3: the anchor is inconsistent (fail closed)

cases.name: a planted record at the highest epoch beside a high-water of 0
cases.unusable: the TPM record is for epoch 18446744073709551615 but the TPM high-water is 0: the anchor is inconsistent (fail closed)

cases.name: a planted record at the highest epoch beside a high-water of 3
cases.unusable: the TPM record is for epoch 18446744073709551615 but the TPM high-water is 3: the anchor is inconsistent (fail closed)

cases.name: a slot the TPM describes and does not read
cases.refused: cannot read 48 bytes from the record index 0x150001b: the anchor is unavailable (fail closed)

cases.name: a base the TPM does not read
cases.refused: cannot read 8 bytes from NV index 0x1500017

cases.name: an index the TPM lists and does not describe
cases.refused: cannot read NV index 0x150001a: the high-water anchor is unavailable (fail closed): the TPM lists it and did not give it

cases.name: a TPM that does not answer
cases.refused: the TPM does not answer (tpm2_getcap handles-nv-index failed): the high-water anchor is unavailable (fail closed)
